Iris (Marketing): Heads-up  Reuters just asked for a timed exclusive at 09:00 ET for our Optimize benchmarks. They say "morning edition". Should we consider?
Drew (PR): Who's the contact? Any prior exclusives with them?
Iris (Marketing): Senior reporter Leah C. Sent an email, no legal embargo attached. Wants to go live at 09:00 ET tomorrow. Our scheduled publish is 14:00 PT.
Felix (Ops): CMS slot locked for 14:00 PT. We can manually publish earlier but that breaks partner newsletter and scheduled socials. Ops needs final assets 2 hours prior if manual.
Priya (Product): Our demo is set to sync with the 14:00 PT publish. If we move it earlier we must change demo timing and inform presenters. Not ideal.
Drew (PR): My instinct: don't give hard exclusives that disrupt our cadence. Offer embargoed preview access instead. If they push for hard exclusive, escalate to CEO for decision.
Hannah (Legal): Agreed. Without a contract we don't owe them. If we provide a preview, include: "This material is provided under embargo; publication before 14:00 PT without written consent is a breach."
Iris (Marketing): Can we support a preview access at 06:30 PT PT (09:30 ET) and keep live publish at 14:00 PT?
Felix (Ops): We can open preview links at that time; ops will need the preview assets by 06:00 PT.
Drew (PR): Proposal: Offer Leah an embargoed preview at 09:00 ET (06:00 PT) and state live publication remains 14:00 PT. If Reuters insists on publish at 09:00 ET, escalate.
Priya (Product): If it escalates we need 3 things from execs: (1) permission to move demo, (2) marketing/social re-plan, (3) sign-off on partner notifications. That takes time.
Iris (Marketing): I'll draft the reply.
Drew (PR): Draft below. Pls review: ---
Hi Leah, happy to provide an embargoed preview at 09:00 ET. Please confirm you will not publish before 14:00 PT; preview provided under embargo and publication prior to 14:00 PT without written consent is a breach. We can share assets at 06:00 PT for review.
Best, Drew (Redwood Inference)
---
Hannah (Legal): Add a short sentence: "By accepting preview access you agree not to publish before the embargo time." Helps record consent.
Iris (Marketing): Sending now.
Drew (PR): Sent. Pasted reply: ---
Hi Leah  happy to provide an embargoed preview at 09:00 ET. Please confirm you will not publish before 14:00 PT; preview provided under embargo and publication prior to 14:00 PT without written consent is a breach. By accepting preview access you agree not to publish before the embargo time. Assets available at 06:00 PT.
Best, Drew
---
publish-bot: notification  embargo.offer.sent post_id=optimize-2026-13 at 1932104720
Iris (Marketing): Leah replied: "Can you do 09:00 ET live?" She says her editor wants the morning run.
Drew (PR): Ok that's a hard ask. Escalating to Sam (CEO) as discussed. Sam, we need guidance: keep schedule or grant Reuters early publish?
Sam (CEO): Put both options with tradeoffs. My quick read: prefer to keep our demo & partner cadence. Reuters is important but not worth fragmenting the rollout unless there's strategic value (e.g., exclusive pickup by other major outlets). Any sign other outlets will refuse to coordinate?
Priya (Product): No other outlets asked for early publish. Our partners rely on 14:00 PT. Moving could cause downstream confusion for demos and partner newsletters.
Hannah (Legal): If execs decide to grant exclusive, get a written embargo/exclusive agreement (email ok) confirming Reuters' exclusive window and that they will not republish elsewhere until we lift. Also log it in the embargo tracker.
Sam (CEO): Decision: hold to 14:00 PT. Offer embargoed preview only. If Reuters threatens to publish anyway, we'll call their bluff and proceed with scheduled publish.
Drew (PR): I'll reply to Leah with the hold.
Iris (Marketing): Ops note: staging preview assets to be uploaded at 06:00 PT; live assets stay queued for 14:00 PT. Felix, confirm.
Felix (Ops): Confirmed. publish-bot: scheduled_preview.create post_id=optimize-2026-13; preview_time=06:00 PT; publish_time=14:00 PT at 1932104920
Drew (PR): Reply sent: ---
Hi Leah  thanks for the note. We can offer an embargoed preview at 09:00 ET; however, live publication remains at 14:00 PT to preserve partner and demo coordination. Please confirm you'll hold until then.
Best, Drew
---
Iris (Marketing): Leah replied saying she understands but "may still run if editor insists".
Drew (PR): Noted. We'll keep monitoring. If they publish early, we have contingency: (1) send a statement calling out that an early article ran in breach of embargo and (2) accelerate social to align with that article while keeping our official publish at 14:00 PT.
Felix (Ops): Ops can accelerate social/manual publish if needed. Need green light from PR to trigger.
Sam (CEO): Agreed contingency. Keep me posted. If Reuters runs early and it's high impact, we'll consider a short exec quote to accompany the article.
Iris (Marketing): Logging actions: Drew -> track Reuters; Felix -> stage preview + keep live; Priya -> prepare short FAQ for press; Hannah -> add embargo wording to preview link; Sam -> on-call if escalation.

Drew (PR): On it. Leaving thread open. If Reuters publishes early, ping #execs immediately.
